name: sage
description: The reality gate. Two actions cover the whole turn lifecycle: `preflight` (before any action — registry scan + no-scratch rule) and `askSage` (before any user-facing message — WWCD question gate + success-claim reality gate). Both are also enforced via .claude hooks. Also owns the plan gate for reusable abstractions, the concurrent-session branch lock, and the canonical Quest Report / BCS reporting standard.
